proof_body:
by
  intro a b s t n ha
  have hne : ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hF : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc s t, HasDerivAt (fun x => (a * x + b) ^ (n + 1) / (a * ((n : ℝ) + 1))) ((a * x + b) ^ n) x := by
    intro x _
    have h : HasDerivAt (fun y => a * y + b) a x := ((hasDerivAt_id' x).const_mul a).add_const b |>.congr_deriv (by ring)
    refine ((h.fun_pow (n + 1)).div_const _).congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    push_cast
    field_simp
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hF ((by fun_prop : Continuous fun x : ℝ => (a * x + b) ^ n).intervalIntegrable s t)]
  ring
